messages:
maria (Sales): FYI @ben @kailey ACME wants to POC a custom Llama-3-30B variant next week — they claim it's 30B with LoRA adapters + a custom tokenizer. Need catalog fit, quant/kv compatibility, and enterprise pricing for reserved capacity. POC timeline: Mon-Tue next week. Can we preflight?

ben (Solutions Eng): Can you drop the model tarball link and a sample request distribution? Important: sequence length, avg tokens/request, peak qps. Also, does the adapter require custom ops?

maria (Sales): Link: s3://acme-poc/models/llama30b-lora-v2.tar.gz (will share IAM soon). Avg tokens ~400, peak ~20 rps, tail ~4k seq for a handful of requests. Adapters are standard LoRA in PyTorch per their note — no custom CUDA ops listed.

ben (Solutions Eng): Ok. Two quick flags: 1) If they expect >2k seq we might need chunked KV cache support; our runtime supports prefix caching but long tails need memory validation. 2) Quant profile: float16 is fine, int8 quantization might need validation with LoRA fused params. I'll run a local compatibility pass once I get the weights.

kailey (Security): @maria thanks — send the security questionnaire answers ASAP. Key items we need: data residency requirement, KMS usage (do they require BYOK/ HSM?), whether model weights contain any customer PII, and whether inference will call external APIs. Also need their SOC2 or security contact for MSA review.

oliver (AE): Pricing note — for a POC with reserved capacity + enterprise SLA, we should quote a short reserved pool (2 weeks) and per-token overage. I'll draft a number but need expected sustained throughput. If they do 20 rps with 400 tokens that's ~576k tokens/hr (rough calc).

ben (Solutions Eng): Quick repro commands I will run once IAM is set up:
```
# test run, using local staging runtime
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/models/test/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model_path":"s3://acme-poc/models/llama30b-lora-v2","inputs":"<sample>","max_tokens":4096}'
```

arjun (Product): If LoRA is applied at load time we should add a catalog variant that pins quant and kv-cache settings. Recommend we create `llama-30b-acme-lora:v1 (int8-validated, kv-enabled)` as a temporary catalog entry; this helps routing, rollout and billing isolation.

maria (Sales): I'll get IAM + security answers today. @ben can you run a quick perf estimate for 20 rps and a 4k tail? If we need extra GPUs for tails we'll raise the POC pricing.

ben (Solutions Eng): Will do. Expect a short report by EOD incl. perf numbers and whether any runtime patch is needed. If I hit custom ops I'll flag immediately.

deploy-bot: deploy: model-variant-scan started for s3://acme-poc/models/llama30b-lora-v2 — job id job_20270325_11

customer_jane (Acme): Thanks team — sending IAM link now, I'll also upload a short sample prompt set (10 examples) to S3.
